headline: Congress named a Little Rock, Arkansas post office after Ronald A. Robinson.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5420 Kavanaugh Boulevard in Little Rock, Arkansas, as the Ronald A. Robinson Post Office. It is a naming change only. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing at the office.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the new name applies from that date.
